meta.name: geomaster
meta.description: Comprehensive geospatial science skill covering remote sensing, GIS, spatial analysis, machine learning for earth observation, and 30+ scientific domains. Supports satellite imagery processing (Sentinel, Landsat, MODIS, SAR, hyperspectral), vector and raster data operations, spatial statistics, point cloud processing, network analysis, cloud-native workflows (STAC, COG, Planetary Computer), and 8 programming languages (Python, R, Julia, JavaScript, C++, Java, Go, Rust) with 500+ code examples. Use for remote sensing workflows, GIS analysis, spatial ML, Earth observation data processing, terrain analysis, hydrological modeling, marine spatial analysis, atmospheric science, and any geospatial computation task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析卫星影像与地理空间数据,构建空间机器学习模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常处理卫星影像和地理空间数据,需要多语言示例
copy.tagline_en: Process satellite imagery and geospatial data, and build spatial machine learning models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with remote sensing and GIS data and need code examples in multiple languages

howto.what: 安装后,当 Claude 处理地理空间任务时,会给出遥感、GIS、空间分析相关的代码示例与操作流程,例如用 Rasterio 处理卫星影像、用 GeoPandas 做矢量分析、用 STAC 检索云上数据。
howto.when: 当用户提出遥感影像处理、GIS 分析、空间机器学习等地理空间计算需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Sentinel-2 影像算这个区域的 NDVI。
对这两个 GeoJSON 做空间连接并按区统计数值。
say.note: 会生成 GeoPandas 空间连接与分组统计的代码。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude provides code and workflows for geospatial tasks: satellite imagery processing with Rasterio, vector analysis with GeoPandas, cloud retrieval via STAC.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests geospatial computation tasks such as remote sensing image processing, GIS analysis, or spatial machine learning.

say_en.text: Calculate NDVI for this area from Sentinel-2 imagery.

say_en.text: Spatially join these two GeoJSON files and summarize values by zone.
say_en.note: Provides GeoPandas code for spatial join and group stats.

say_en.text: Search Sentinel-2 images from 2023 with cloud cover below 20% via STAC.
